description: "Use when editing CI workflows, Dependabot configuration, packaging scripts or release assets. Covers workflow conventions, Avalonia version policy and MSIX/macOS packaging."
applyTo: [".github/**", "packaging/**"]
---
# CI, Dependabot and packaging rules

## Workflows (`.github/workflows`)
- `ci.yml` jobs: `build`, `test` (windows + macos), `build-avalonia` (windows + macos, runs `--smoke` on Windows), `build-wpf` (windows), `package-macos` (signed + notarized `.app`, artifact `SfUi-macos-app`), plus `Analyze`/CodeQL. Keep 10 checks green.
- GitHub Actions used: `actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/setup-dotnet@v6`, `actions/upload-artifact@v7`, `github/codeql-action/*@v4`. Bump only when the Dependabot PR's own run passed.
- Do not exclude Dependabot checks when reporting CI status.

## Dependabot (`.github/dependabot.yml`)
- Avalonia packages are **grouped** (`Avalonia*`) and **major updates are ignored** — they must stay on one 11.x line.
- `Microsoft.Extensions.*` is grouped. Other majors may be merged when their PR CI is green; final verification is `dotnet build` + full tests on `main`.

## Version bump (release)
- `src/SfUi.App/SfUi.App.csproj` and `src/SfUi.Avalonia/SfUi.Avalonia.csproj`: `<Version>`.
- `packaging/AppxManifest.xml`: `Package/Identity/@Version` (4 parts, e.g. `0.21.0.0`).
- `README.md`: download file names (`SfUi-v<ver>-portable.zip`, `SfUi-<ver>-x64.msix/.cer`, `SfUi-<ver>-osx-arm64.zip`) and the Japanese changelog line.
- `packaging/layout/AppxManifest.xml` is generated by `packaging/Make-Msix.ps1` — never edit by hand.

## Packaging
- `packaging/Make-Msix.ps1` publishes the single-file exe to `dist\`, builds the layout, runs `makepri`/`makeappx`, signs with `packaging/sign/SfUi_TemporaryKey.pfx` (password `sfui-test`) and exports `dist\SfUi_<ver>_x64.cer`.
- Store identity: `HKS.SfUi`, publisher `CN=F23B2630-3909-43D6-9071-F53B9E511923`, architecture `x64`, `MinVersion 10.0.17763.0` (Store requires > 10.0.17134.0).
- macOS `.app` is built and notarized in CI (`packaging/make-mac-app.sh`, `packaging/mac/`); the artifact contains the final `SfUi-<ver>-osx-arm64.zip`.
- Full release procedure: `.github/skills/sfui-release`.
